mechanism: Phenelzine is an MAOI that inhibits monoamine oxidase, while valproic acid can increase CNS depression and may potentiate MAOI effects; additionally, valproic acid may displace phenelzine from protein binding, increasing free drug levels.
action: Avoid concurrent use or use only with careful monitoring and dose adjustment; if combination is necessary, initiate phenelzine at lowest dose and monitor for excessive CNS depression, hypotension, and serotonergic effects.
